arXiv:2604.12767v1 [cs.CV] 2026 年 4 月 14 日arXiv:2604.12767v1 [cs.CV] 14 Apr 2026

CLASP：多模态大型语言模型的类自适应层融合和双阶段剪枝CLASP: Class-Adaptive Layer Fusion and Dual-Stage Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models

Yunkai Dang*    Yizhu Jiang*    Yifan Jiang    Qi Fan    Yinghuan Shi    Wenbin Li†\dagger    Yang Gao
摘要Abstract

由于视觉标记序列的大量冗余，多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 面临着巨大的计算开销。 为了减轻这种冗余，现有的工作通常依赖于单层 ViT 特征和静态剪枝策略。 然而，这些固定的配置通常会使它们在不同的指令中变得脆弱。 为了解决这些限制，我们提出Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from substantial computational overheads, driven by the massive redundancy of visual token sequences. To mitigate such redundancy, existing works typically rely on single-layer ViT features and static pruning strategies. However, these fixed configurations often render them brittle across diverse instructions. To address these limitations, we present类自适应层融合和双阶段剪枝（CLASP）class-adaptive layer fusion and dual-stage pruning (CLASP)，即插即用的代币缩减框架。 具体来说，我们通过多层视觉特征融合构建特定类别的视觉表示。 然后，我们执行双阶段修剪，在注意显着枢轴（相关性）和冗余感知完成标记（覆盖范围）之间分配标记预算。 通过类自适应修剪，我们的方法表明，提示条件特征融合和预算分配可以实现积极而稳健的视觉标记修剪。 实验表明，与现有方法相比，我们的方法在各种基准、剪枝比率和 MLLM 架构上都实现了卓越的性能。 代码将在以下位置提供：, a plug-and-play token reduction framework. Specifically, we construct a category-specific visual representation via multi-layer vision feature fusion. Then we perform dual-stage pruning that allocates the token budget between attention-salient pivots (relevance) and redundancy-aware completion tokens (coverage). By class-adaptively pruning, our method shows that prompt-conditioned feature fusion and budget allocation enable aggressive yet robust visual token pruning. Experiments show that our method achieves superior performance across various benchmarks, pruning ratios, and MLLM architectures compared to existing methods. Code will be available athttps://github.com/Yunkaidang/CLASP.

机器学习、ICML、视觉语言模型Machine Learning, ICML, Vision Language Models

1 简介Introduction

多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 将 LLM 的指令跟踪和推理能力扩展到视觉领域Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) extend the instruction-following and reasoning capabilities of LLMs to the visual domain(yin2024survey，dang2024explainable)。 这些模型通常通过对齐模块将预训练的视觉编码器与自回归语言解码器对齐. These models typically align pre-trained vision encoders with autoregressive language decoders through an alignment module(Wu et al., 2023)。 尽管它们在各种多式联运基准测试中表现出色. Despite their impressive performance across various multimodal benchmarks(Liu et al., 2024d; Fu et al., 2025)，MLLM 在实际应用中面临着重大挑战。 主要瓶颈源于与处理视觉标记相关的大量计算开销。 在这些架构中，图像通常被序列化为长的、高密度的补丁级令牌序列, MLLMs face significant challenges in practical utility. The primary bottleneck stems from the substantial computational overhead associated with processing visual tokens. In these architectures, images are typically serialized into long, high-density sequences of patch-level tokens(Jin et al., 2025)。 这种表示导致自注意力的计算成本与输入分辨率成二次方缩放。 例如，将输入分辨率从. This representation causes the computational cost of self-attention to scale quadratically with the input resolution. For instance, increasing the input resolution from336×336336\times 336在 LLaVA-1.5 中in LLaVA-1.5(Liu et al., 2023a) to 672×672672\times 672在 LLaVA-NeXT 中in LLaVA-NeXT(Liu et al., 2024b)增加令牌计数raises the token count from576576到一个惊人的to a staggering2,8802,880。 令牌的激增对内存占用和推理延迟提出了过高的要求。 最终，这些开销对高效推理和部署造成了主要障碍. Such a proliferation of tokens imposes excessive demands on both memory footprint and inference latency. Ultimately, these overheads create a major barrier to efficient inference and deployment(Kong et al., 2025).

为了降低 MLLM 的推理成本，最近的研究To reduce the inference cost of MLLMs, recent studies(Xing et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024a; Zhang et al., 2024b; Bolya et al., 2022; Wen et al., 2025a; Zou et al., 2025b)提出令牌减少方法来修剪视觉令牌。 现有的方法可以大致分为两个主要方向。 第一行利用跨模式注意力分数propose token reduction approaches to prune visual tokens. Existing approaches can be broadly grouped into two primary directions. The first line leverages cross-modal attention scores(Chen et al., 2024a; Zhang et al., 2024b; Zhan et al., 2024; Arif et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025a)识别并保留与指令相关的视觉区域，主要关注标记相关性。 第二行采用基于相似性的剪枝to identify and retain instruction-relevant visual regions, primarily focusing on token relevance. The second line employs similarity-based pruning(Bolya et al., 2022; Xing et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2025; Alvar et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025b)通过合并或删除低显着性标记来删除冗余补丁，强调视觉信息的覆盖范围。 虽然现有方法从各个角度都取得了有希望的结果，但大多数方法仍然依赖于类别不敏感和固定策略来进行视觉特征提取和标记修剪。 具体来说，这些方法依赖于单个或一组固定的 ViT 层来导出视觉表示。 这些静态表示既充当修剪信号又充当解码器输入，但它们无法捕获特定于任务的细微差别。 建立在这个静态基础上，现有方法to remove redundant patches by merging or dropping low-saliency tokens, emphasizing the coverage of visual information. While existing approaches have achieved promising results from various perspectives, most methods still rely on category-insensitive and fixed strategies for both visual feature extraction and token pruning. Specifically, these methods rely on a single or a fixed set of ViT layers to derive visual representations. These static representations serve as both pruning signals and decoder inputs, yet they fail to capture task-specific nuances. Building on this static foundation, existing methods(Chen et al., 2024a; Zhang et al., 2024b; Wen et al., 2025a; Zou et al., 2025b)然后应用具有预定义参数的严格修剪策略，无论指令类别如何。 然而，这些方法忽略了一个关键的细微差别：不同的意图强调不同的水平then apply a rigid pruning strategy with predefined parameters, regardless of the instruction category. However, such methods overlook a critical nuance: different intents emphasize distinct levels of视觉抽象visual abstraction并对空间提出不同的要求and impose varying requirements on spatial相关性和覆盖范围relevance and coverage.

基于这些见解，我们认为视觉特征提取和标记修剪都应该根据输入问题类别进行动态调整。 为了验证这一点，我们评估了固定代币预算下特定指令类别对不同配置的敏感性（MM-Vet、LLaVA-v1.5-7B、Based on these insights, we contend that both visual feature extraction and token pruning should be dynamically adjusted according to input question categories. To verify this, we evaluate the sensitivity of specific instruction categories to different configurations under a fixed token budget (MM-Vet, LLaVA-v1.5-7B,R=192R=192）。 我们首先对优化视觉特征提取的层混合策略进行初步分析（图 1）。). We first conduct a preliminary analysis on layer-mixture strategies to optimize visual feature extraction (Fig.1，顶部）。 具体来说，我们采用多种方案（A, top). Specifically, we employ multiple schemes (A→\rightarrowE) 将融合重点从浅层 ViT 层转移到深层 ViT 层。 结果表明，模型精度根据集成特征的层深度而显着变化。 例如，随着融合重点从混合层转向深层，计数类别的性能会下降（E) that shift the fusion emphasis from shallow to deep ViT layers. The results indicate that model accuracy varies significantly depending on the layer depth of the integrated features. For instance, the performance of the Count category degrades as the fusion emphasis shifts from hybrid to deep layers (29.529.5 与vs.27.927.9）。 为了进一步检查修剪标准的影响，我们研究了依赖注意力和相似性之间固定平衡的局限性（图 1）。). To further examine the impact of pruning criteria, we investigate the limitations of relying on a fixed balance between attention and similarity (Fig.1，底部）。 我们实施了一种混合策略，可以在注意力主导模式和相似性主导模式之间转换剪枝逻辑。 研究结果表明，单一的静态混合比无法为每个类别实现最佳性能。 具体来说，基于文本的类别以较低的比率达到最高准确度（, bottom). We implement a hybrid strategy that transitions the pruning logic between attention-led and similarity-led modes. The findings show that a single, static mixing ratio fails to achieve optimal performance for every category. Specifically, text-based categories reach peak accuracy at lower ratios (≈0.3\approx 0.3），而计数类别需要更高的比率（), whereas counting categories require higher ratios (0.70.7–0.90.9）在 MMVet 中。 这些结果证实，有效的令牌减少需要分层特征集成的类感知适应以及相关性和覆盖范围之间的平衡。) in MMVet. These results confirm that effective token reduction requires class-aware adaptation of both layer-wise feature integration and the balance between relevance and coverage.

受此证据的启发，我们建议Motivated by this evidence, we propose类自适应层融合和双阶段剪枝（CLASP）class-adaptive layer fusion and dual-stage pruning (CLASP)，一个动态融合视觉特征和修剪标记的框架。 特别地，我们首先介绍, a framework that dynamically fuses visual features and prunes tokens. In particular, we first introduce类自适应层融合class-adaptive layer fusion以优化视觉表现。 该模块不依赖于单个 ViT 层，而是根据输入指令自适应地集成来自多个层的视觉特征。 该过程保留了与类别相关的局部细节，同时有效地去除了冗余信息。 基于这些优化的表示，我们实现了to optimize the visual representation. Instead of relying on a single ViT layer, this module adaptively integrates visual features from multiple layers, conditioned on the input instructions. This process preserves category-relevant local details while effectively removing redundant information. Building on these optimized representations, we implement a类自适应双阶段剪枝策略class-adaptive dual-stage pruning strategy。 修剪过程包括一个相关性保留阶段，以保护关键证据。 接下来是面向覆盖的阶段，以维护必要的上下文，同时进一步减少冗余。 我们通过一套全面的八个图像基准和三个视频基准来评估我们的方法。 结果表明，我们的方法始终超越现有的最先进的令牌修剪方法。 值得注意的是，我们的方法保留了大约. The pruning process consists of a relevance-preserving stage to protect key evidence. It is followed by a coverage-oriented stage to maintain the necessary context while further reducing redundancy. We evaluate our method across a comprehensive suite of eight image benchmarks and three video benchmarks. The results demonstrate that our approach consistently surpasses existing state-of-the-art token pruning methods. Notably, our method preserves approximately94.7%94.7\%即使令牌减少高达原始性能of the original performance even with a token reduction of up to88.9%88.9\%。 此外，我们的方法是即插即用的，并且可以轻松集成到各种 MLLM 架构中，这使得我们的框架非常适合高效的实际部署。. Besides, our method is plug-and-play and easily integrable into various MLLM architectures, which makes our framework well-suited for efficient practical deployment.

总而言之，我们的主要贡献如下：In summary, our main contributions are as follows:

  • •

    我们揭示了从固定 ViT 层提取视觉特征的局限性以及对固定注意力或固定相似性机制的依赖。We reveal the limitations of visual feature extraction from fixed ViT layers and the reliance on fixed attention or fixed similarity mechanisms.

  • •

    我们提出类自适应层融合来提取更多与类别相关的视觉表示。We propose class-adaptive layer fusion to extract more category-relevant visual representations.

  • •

    我们引入了一种类自适应双阶段修剪策略来平衡视觉标记的相关性和覆盖率要求。We introduce a class-adaptive dual-stage pruning strategy to balance the relevance and coverage requirements of visual tokens.

  • •

    我们通过各种基准评估我们的方法，证明了与现有方法相比，在准确性与效率权衡方面的持续改进。We evaluate our method across various benchmarks, demonstrating consistent improvements in the accuracy–efficiency trade-off over existing approaches.

2 相关工作Related Work

视觉语言模型 (VLM)。Vision-language Models (VLMs).

多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 通过对齐接口将视觉编码器与 LLM 耦合来实现视觉推理Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable visual reasoning by coupling vision encoders with LLMs through alignment interfaces(yin2024survey，dang2025exploring)，比如投影仪, such as projectors(Liu et al., 2023a, 2024a)或基于查询的连接器or query-based connectors(Li et al., 2023b; Dai et al., 2023)。 为了增强这些功能，后续系统重点关注扩展视觉主干、训练数据和指令调整配方. To enhance these capabilities, subsequent systems have focused on scaling vision backbones, training data, and instruction-tuning recipes(Zhu et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024b; Zhu et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2026)。 然而，随着这些模型的扩展，将冗余视觉输入序列化为长标记序列会带来巨大的计算负担。 在处理高分辨率图像时，这种负担变得尤其严重，由此导致的序列长度爆炸导致令人望而却步的推理延迟. However, as these models scale, the serialization of redundant visual inputs into long token sequences imposes a significant computational burden. This burden becomes particularly acute when handling high-resolution images, where the resulting explosion in sequence length leads to prohibitive inference latency(Liu et al., 2023a, 2024b; An et al., 2025)。 除了效率之外，当前的 MLLM 仍然在与细粒度的视觉感知作斗争，通常会导致感知差距和幻觉. Beyond efficiency, current MLLMs still struggle with fine-grained visual perception, often leading to perception gaps and hallucinations(Li et al., 2023c; Yu et al., 2024; Dang et al., 2025)。 这些感知缺陷表明迫切需要更忠实的视觉表示和可扩展的上下文处理. These perceptual shortcomings indicate a pressing need for more faithful visual representations and scalable context handling(Zou et al., 2025b; Wen et al., 2025b)。 主要的结构瓶颈是大多数基于投影仪的模型仅从单个静态且通常较晚的视觉编码器层提取令牌。 由于依赖于这种固定的提取点，这些模型无法动态地使视觉抽象级别适应不同指令的特定要求。. A primary structural bottleneck is that most projector-based models extract tokens from only a single, static and often late, vision-encoder layer. By relying on such a fixed extraction point, these models fail to dynamically adapt the level of visual abstraction to the specific requirements of diverse instructions.

视觉标记压缩和修剪。Visual Token Compression and Pruning.

视觉标记压缩和修剪已成为减轻长序列二次注意力成本的关键技术，特别是随着 MLLM 越来越多地处理高分辨率输入。 为了实现这种有效的减少，已经开发了各种方法，其重要性信号和优化目标不同，例如指令相关性与冗余。 基于注意力的方法，例如 FastVVisual token compression and pruning have emerged as pivotal techniques to alleviate the quadratic attention cost of long sequences, particularly as MLLMs increasingly handle high-resolution inputs. To achieve such efficient reduction, various methodologies have been developed, differing in their importance signals and optimization goals, such as instruction relevance versus redundancy. Attention-based approaches, like FastV(Chen et al., 2024a)和VTWand VTW(Lin et al., 2025b)，通常使用跨模式注意模式来修剪标记，而 PyramidDrop, typically prune tokens using cross-modal attention patterns, while PyramidDrop(Xing et al., 2024)作用于视觉主干内的模式内注意力。 SparseVLM 等指令引导方法operates on intra-modal attention inside the vision backbone. Instruction-guided methods like SparseVLM(Zhang et al., 2024b)进一步加强文本指令的作用来调节这些注意信号。 然而，基于注意力的标准通常是嘈杂的，并且往往会保留高度重复的标记。 为了解决这个问题，相似性驱动的方法（further strengthen the role of textual instructions to condition these attention signals. However, attention-based criteria are often noisy and tend to retain highly duplicated tokens. To address this, similarity-driven methods (例如e.g., 给我, ToMe(Bolya et al., 2022), 视觉压缩, VisionZip(Yang et al., 2025), 嗨红, HiRED(Arif et al., 2025), 维斯普鲁纳, VisPruner(Zhang et al., 2025a)）利用内在的视觉线索来管理冗余并保持表示多样性。 尽管如此，这些方法从根本上受到固定层视觉读出的限制，无法提供不同任务所需的自适应视觉抽象水平。 此外，他们采用严格的修剪策略，无法根据特定意图类别平衡指令相关性和视觉覆盖范围。 相比之下，CLASP 利用推断的指令类别来动态指导多层视觉特征融合和混合注意力相似性修剪。) leverage intrinsic visual cues to manage redundancy and maintain representation diversity. Nonetheless, these approaches are fundamentally limited by a fixed-layer visual readout, which fails to provide the adaptive level of visual abstraction required by diverse tasks. Furthermore, they employ a rigid pruning policy that cannot balance instruction relevance and visual coverage according to the specific intent category. In contrast, CLASP leverages the inferred instruction category to dynamically guide both multi-layer visual feature fusion and hybrid attention-similarity pruning.

3 初步Preliminary

MLLM 的架构。Architecture of MLLMs.

我们考虑一个多模态 LLM，它由 (i) 一个视觉编码器组成We consider a multimodal LLM consisting of (i) a vision encoder withLL层， (ii) 轻量级视觉文本界面（layers, (ii) a lightweight vision–text interface (例如e.g.，投影仪），以及（iii）因果文本解码器。 具体来说，视觉编码器从输入图像中提取视觉特征，然后将其与文本嵌入空间对齐以指导生成过程。 样品, a projector), and (iii) a causal text decoder. Specifically, the vision encoder extracts visual features from input images, which are then aligned with the text embedding space to guide the generation process. 概述。Overview.

给出提示Given a promptxnx_{n}和输入图像and an input image𝐈n\mathbf{I}_{n}，我们的目标是减少, our goal is to reduce the有效的effective多模态解码器处理的视觉标记数量达到目标预算number of visual tokens processed by the multimodal decoder to a target budgetRR，同时保留指令相关内容并维持令牌覆盖范围。 关注 SparseVLM, while preserving instruction-relevant content and maintaining token coverage. Following SparseVLM(Zhang et al., 2024b)，我们采用三阶段渐进剪枝方案并稀疏中间解码器层的视觉标记集, we adopt a three-stage progressive pruning schedule and sparsify the visual token set at intermediate decoder layers{2,6,15}\{2,6,15\}。 配置分阶段保留预算以匹配目标有效预算. The stage-wise retention budgets are configured to match the target effective budgetRR。 如图所示. As illustrated in Figure2，我们的方法引入了两个由提示类路由器驱动的类自适应组件： (一), our method introduces two class-adaptive components driven by a prompt-to-class router: (i)类自适应层融合class-adaptive layer fusion，它形成了多层视觉表示的类别条件混合，并且 (二), which forms a category-conditioned mixture of multi-layer vision representations, and (ii)类自适应剪枝class-adaptive pruning，它在注意力突出枢轴（相关性）和低冗余完成标记（覆盖范围）之间分配每个阶段的预算。 完整的过程总结在算法中, which allocates each stage budget between attention-salient pivots (relevance) and low-redundancy completion tokens (coverage). The complete procedure is summarized in Algorithm1.

4.1 类自适应层融合Class-Adaptive Layer Fusion

动机和设计原则。Motivation and Design Principle.

MLLM 中的视觉支柱（Vision backbones in MLLMs (例如e.g.，ViT 风格的编码器）表现出众所周知的深度层次结构： 较浅的层保留局部纹理、边缘和精细的空间布局，而较深的层变得越来越语义和不变。 我们的研究（第二节）, ViT-style encoders) exhibit a well-known depth hierarchy: shallower layers preserve local texture, edges, and fine spatial layouts, while deeper layers become increasingly semantic and invariant. Our study (Sec.1，图。, Fig.1) 表明) indicates that剪枝的最佳特征粒度取决于指令类别the optimal feature granularity for pruning depends on the instruction category: 以细节为中心的说明（: detail-centric instructions (例如e.g.、OCR、计数）受益于保留中/浅线索，而整体指令（, OCR, counting) benefit from retaining mid/shallow cues, whereas holistic instructions (例如e.g.，场景理解）更喜欢更深层次的抽象。 因此，我们不是从固定深度提取视觉表示，而是构建一个提示条件深度混合，自适应地平衡细粒度和语义表示。, scene understanding) prefer deeper abstractions. Therefore, instead of extracting visual representations from a fixed depth, we construct a prompt-conditioned depth mixture that adaptively balances fine-grained and semantic representations.

5 实验Experiment

基准。Benchmarks.我们根据十个既定基准评估多模态能力，涵盖一般视觉理解、组合推理、以 OCR 为中心的推理、现实世界的鲁棒性、物体幻觉和视频理解。 为了图像理解，我们使用 质量保证局We evaluate multimodal capability on ten established benchmarks spanning general visual understanding, compositional reasoning, OCR-centric reasoning, real-world robustness, object hallucination, and video comprehension. For image understanding, we use GQA(Hudson and Manning, 2019), MMBench (Liu et al., 2024d), 微机电系统, MME(Fu et al., 2025), 教皇, POPE(Li et al., 2023c), VQAv2 (Goyal et al., 2017), 科学质量保证, ScienceQA(Lu et al., 2022), 和文本VQA, and TextVQA(Singh et al., 2019)。 为了评估时间推理和视频能力，我们进一步包括 TGIF. To assess temporal reasoning and video capability, we further include TGIF(Li et al., 2016)对于动画 GIF 描述，MSVDfor animated GIF description, MSVD(Chen and Dolan, 2011)用于视频字幕和 MSRVTTfor video captioning, and MSRVTT(Xu et al., 2016)用于开放域视频描述。 我们遵循官方数据集分割和评估协议，报告每个基准的标准指标，以确保可重复性和公平比较。for open-domain video description. We follow the official dataset splits and evaluation protocols, reporting the standard metrics for each benchmark to ensure reproducibility and fair comparison.

模型和比较方法。Models and Comparison Methods.我们将我们的方法应用于各种 MLLM 架构，包括 LLaVA 系列：LLaVA-1.5We apply our method to various MLLM architectures, including the LLaVA series: LLaVA-1.5(Liu et al., 2024a)用于图像理解，LLaVA-NeXTfor image understanding, LLaVA-NeXT(Liu et al., 2024b)用于高分辨率输入和视频-LLaVAfor high-resolution inputs, and Video-LLaVA(Zhang et al., 2024c)用于视频理解，以及开源模型 Qwen2.5-VLfor video understanding, as well as the open-source model Qwen2.5-VL(Bai et al., 2025)。 为了进行以效率为导向的比较，我们对 MLLM 的最先进的代币减少方法进行了基准测试，包括 ToMe. For efficiency-oriented comparisons, we benchmark against state-of-the-art token reduction methods for MLLMs, including ToMe(Bolya et al., 2022), LLaVA-PruMerge (Shang et al., 2025), 快速V, FastV(Chen et al., 2024a), 嗨红, HiRED(Arif et al., 2025), P 滴, PDrop(Xing et al., 2024), 多阶段视觉代币掉落, Multi-Stage Vision Token Dropping(Liu et al., 2024c), 稀疏VLM, SparseVLM(Zhang et al., 2024b), 视觉压缩, VisionZip(Yang et al., 2025)、和飞镖, and DART(Wen et al., 2025b)。 附录中提供了有关模型架构和其他实验结果的更多详细信息. More details regarding the model architectures and additional experimental results are provided in AppendixA和附录and AppendixD.

Across three retention budgets (192/128/64 tokens;↓\downarrow66.7%/↓\downarrow77.8%/↓\downarrow88.9%），我们的方法始终达到最佳标准化平均值（98.4%/97.0%/94.7%）。 凭借 192 个代币，我们总体保留了 98.4%，并获得了最强的 GQA 结果 (60.4) 以及在其余基准上的竞争性能，同时大幅提高了经典缩减基准（88.9%), our method consistently achieves the best normalized average (98.4%/97.0%/94.7%). With 192 tokens, we retain 98.4% overall and obtain the strongest GQA result (60.4) together with competitive performance on the remaining benchmarks, while improving over classical reduction baselines by large margins (例如e.g.，比 ToMe +9.9% 和 +10.6%, +9.9% and +10.6% over ToMe(Bolya et al., 2022)和FastVand FastV(Chen et al., 2024a)）。 在 128 个代币的情况下，我们总体保持 97.0% 并达到最佳 POPE 准确率 (85.2)，这表明在预算紧张的情况下提高了忠诚度。 即使有 64 个 token，我们的方法总体保留了 94.7%，优于基于相似性的方法 DART). Even with 64 tokens, our method preserves 94.7% overall, outperforming the similarity-based method DART(Wen et al., 2025b)+1.7%，同时进一步扩大了基于注意力的方法的优势（比 PDrop +22.0%by +1.7%, while further extending the margin over attention-based methods (+22.0% over PDrop(Xing et al., 2024)比 FastV +23.6%and +23.6% over FastV(Chen et al., 2024a)）。 总的来说，这些结果表明我们的方法更有效地保留了关键的视觉证据，特别是在极低的标记设置中。). Overall, these results show that our method preserves critical visual evidence more effectively, especially in the extreme low-token setting.

更高分辨率的主要结果。Main Results on Higher Resolution.为了进一步综合评估，我们报告了 LLaVA-NeXT 7B 将视觉标记从 2880 减少到 320（aFor further comprehensive evaluation, we report results on LLaVA-NeXT 7B when reducing the visual tokens from 2880 to 320 (a↓88.9%\,\downarrow 88.9\%表中的代币减少）token reduction) in Table2。 遵循与表相同的评估方案. Following the same evaluation protocol as Table1，我们报告原始任务分数和标准化平均值，其中 2880 个令牌模型设置为 100% 以进行跨基准比较。 在如此激进的预算下，我们的方法实现了 95.2% 的最佳归一化平均值，比基于相似性的剪枝方法 DART 有所改进, we report raw task scores and a normalized average where the 2880-token model is set to 100% for cross-benchmark comparison. Under this aggressive budget, our method achieves the best normalized average of 95.2%, improving over the similarity-based pruning method DART(Wen et al., 2025b)提高了 1.3%，并且优于 HiRED 等近期竞争对手by 1.3%, and outperforming recent competitors such as HiRED(Arif et al., 2025)增幅更大（+1.9%）。 除了总体排名之外，我们的方法在七个基准中的四个上获得了最好的分数，包括 GQA (62.7)、MME (1723)、POPE (85.8) 和 TextVQA (61.7)，这表明在严重的标记减少下，任务关键型视觉证据的保留能力更强。 这些结果表明，我们的修剪策略可以很好地适应更高分辨率的标记设置，并且仍然非常有效，在保持准确性的同时大幅缩短视觉上下文长度。by an even larger margin (+1.9%). In addition to the overall ranking, our method attains the best scores on four out of seven benchmarks, including GQA (62.7), MME (1723), POPE (85.8), and TextVQA (61.7), indicating stronger retention of task-critical visual evidence under severe token reduction. These results show that our pruning strategy scales well to higher-resolution token settings and remains highly effective, preserving accuracy while substantially shrinking the visual context length.

Qwen 架构的结果。Results on Qwen Architecture.除了 LLaVA，我们将我们的方法扩展到 Qwen2.5-VL-7BBeyond LLaVA, we extend our method to Qwen2.5-VL-7B(Bai et al., 2025)为了验证其普遍性，在三种代币剪枝率（66.7%、77.8% 和 88.9%）下对其进行评估。 如表所示to validate its generalizability, evaluating it under three token pruning rates (66.7%, 77.8%, and 88.9%). As shown in Table3，我们的方法始终比 SparseVLM 保留更大比例的上限性能, our method consistently retains a larger fraction of the upper-bound performance than SparseVLM(Zhang et al., 2024b)在每个预算下，随着修剪变得更加积极，优势就会扩大。 我们将 66.7% 剪枝时的标准化平均值从 94.1% 提高到 96.5%（+2.4%），将 77.8% 剪枝时的标准化平均值从 90.8% 提高到 94.4%（+3.6%），将 88.9% 剪枝时的标准化平均值从 82.9% 提高到 89.0%（+6.1%）。 这些结果表明我们的剪枝策略有效地转移到了 Qwen2.5-VL 上。 收益在高压缩设置中最为明显，其中保留多样化且与指令相关的视觉证据至关重要，这突显了高级 MLLM 架构的强大通用性。at every budget, and the advantage widens as pruning becomes more aggressive. We improve the normalized average from 94.1% to 96.5% at 66.7% pruning (+2.4%), from 90.8% to 94.4% at 77.8% pruning (+3.6%), and from 82.9% to 89.0% at 88.9% pruning (+6.1%). These results show that our pruning strategy transfers effectively to Qwen2.5-VL. The gains are most pronounced in high-compression settings, where preserving diverse yet instruction-relevant visual evidence is critical, highlighting strong generalizability on advanced MLLM architectures.

视频基准的主要结果。Main Results on Video Benchmarks.为了验证我们的框架在静态图像之外的多功能性，我们使用 Video-LLaVA 将评估扩展到视频领域。如表所示To verify the versatility of our framework beyond static images, we extend our evaluation to the video domain using Video-LLaVA. As presented in Table4，我们在三个代表性基准（TGIF、MSVD 和 MSRVTT）上将 CLASP 与全代币上限和基线 SparseVLM 进行比较。值得注意的是，CLASP 获得了最高的平均得分 52.95，不仅超过了 SparseVLM（51.22），而且超过了未剪枝的 Upper Bound（52.23）。这种相对于全代币基线的性能提升在 TGIF（45.65 vs. 43.47）和 MSRVTT（51.58 vs. 51.28）上尤其明显。我们将此归因于视频流固有的高时间和空间冗余。通过积极过滤掉重复或无信息的标记，我们的方法可能会减少噪音，并允许模型更有效地关注核心时间语义。 总的来说，这些发现证实了我们的相关性多样性修剪机制对于视频理解非常有效。, we compare CLASP against the full-token Upper Bound and the baseline SparseVLM on three representative benchmarks (TGIF, MSVD, and MSRVTT). Remarkably, CLASP achieves the highest average score of 52.95, surpassing not only SparseVLM (51.22) but also the unpruned Upper Bound (52.23). This performance gain over the full-token baseline is particularly evident on TGIF (45.65 vs. 43.47) and MSRVTT (51.58 vs. 51.28). We attribute this to the high temporal and spatial redundancy inherent in video streams. By aggressively filtering out repetitive or non-informative tokens, our method likely reduces noise and allows the model to focus more effectively on core temporal semantics. Overall, these findings confirm that our relevance-diversity pruning mechanism is highly effective for video understanding.

令牌修剪可视化。Token Pruning Visualization.补充定量结果，图 2。Complementing the quantitative results, Fig.3可视化样本中保留标记的空间分布。与通常无法保留显着区域的基线不同，我们的方法始终保留关键区域。我们进一步对保留的视觉区域进行分类：蓝色区域表示根据注意力分数选择的标记，表示高相关性，而红色区域表示根据相似性度量选择的标记，提供上下文覆盖。这种区别强调了我们的方法平衡了不同的视觉方面：蓝色区域捕获主要前景，而红色区域确保背景完整性。随着剪枝率的增加，我们的方法稳健地保留了这些基本线索，有效地过滤了冗余，同时保留了推理所需的核心语义。总体而言，这些定性证据证实，我们的修剪策略保留了视觉理解的关键信息，确保下游任务的稳健对齐。visualizes the spatial distribution of retained tokens across samples. Unlike baselines that often fail to retain salient regions, our method consistently preserves critical areas. We further categorize the retained visual regions: blue regions represent tokens selected based on attention scores, indicating high relevance, while red regions represent tokens selected based on similarity metrics, providing contextual coverage. This distinction emphasizes that our method balances different visual aspects: blue regions capture the primary foreground, while red regions ensure background completeness. As pruning rates increase, our method robustly retains these essential cues, effectively filtering redundancy while preserving the core semantics needed for reasoning. Overall, this qualitative evidence confirms that our pruning strategy preserves pivotal information for visual understanding, ensuring robust alignment for downstream tasks.

6 结论Conclusion

在本文中，我们提出了 CLASP，一个将类自适应层融合与双阶段修剪相结合的框架，以平衡令牌相关性和空间覆盖范围。我们的结果表明，动态缩减可以在不影响细粒度感知的情况下最大限度地减少冗余，标志着从静态视觉编码到条件视觉编码的根本转变。未来的工作应该致力于从手动启发式先验过渡到端到端可学习的路由策略，同时进行更严格的硬件感知协同设计，以在边缘和嵌入式系统上充分实现高效的多模式智能。In this paper, we proposed CLASP, a framework synergizing class-adaptive layer fusion with dual-stage pruning to balance token relevance and spatial coverage. Our results demonstrate that dynamic reduction minimizes redundancy without compromising fine-grained perception, marking a fundamental shift from static to conditional visual encoding. Future work should aim to transition from manual heuristic priors to end-to-end learnable routing policies, alongside tighter hardware-aware co-design to fully realize efficient multimodal intelligence on edge and embodied systems.

影响报告Impact Statement

这项工作通过在不重新训练的情况下修剪冗余视觉标记来减少 MLLM 推理的计算、内存和延迟，这可以降低每次查询的成本和能源，并支持在资源受限的硬件上进行部署。效率的提高可以扩大辅助和设备设置中多模式系统的访问范围。然而，降低多模态推理的边际成本也可能促进有害用途，包括侵犯隐私的分析、大规模监控和大量内容生成。除了更快的推理之外，CLASP 并未添加新功能，但负责任的部署仍然很重要：从业者应遵循数据最小化和同意实践，对视觉输入应用安全存储和访问控制，监控误用，并在敏感领域使用之前验证积极修剪下的稳健性。This work reduces compute, memory, and latency of MLLM inference by pruning redundant visual tokens without retraining, which can lower cost and energy per query and enable deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Improved efficiency may broaden access to multimodal systems in assistive and on-device settings. However, lowering the marginal cost of multimodal inference can also facilitate harmful uses, including privacy-invasive analytics, large-scale surveillance, and high-volume content generation. CLASP does not add new capabilities beyond faster inference, but responsible deployment remains important: practitioners should follow data minimization and consent practices, apply secure storage and access control for visual inputs, monitor misuse, and validate robustness under aggressive pruning before use in sensitive domains.

附录AAppendix A详细的实验设置。Detailed Experiment Settings.

基准和指标。Benchmarks and Metrics.

我们对一套全面的基准进行实验，以评估我们的模型在静态和动态场景中的多模式能力。 对于We conduct experiments on a comprehensive suite of benchmarks to evaluate our model’s multimodal capabilities across both static and dynamic scenarios. For图像理解image understanding，我们在主要评估中使用八个广泛使用的数据集来评估一般感知、组合推理、OCR 和幻觉： 质量保证局, we assess general perception, compositional reasoning, OCR, and hallucination using eight widely used datasets in our main evaluation: GQA(Hudson and Manning, 2019), MMBench (MMB) (Liu et al., 2024d), MMME, MME(Fu et al., 2025), 教皇, POPE(Li et al., 2023c), 科学质量保证 (SQA), ScienceQA (SQA)(Lu et al., 2022), VQAv2 (Goyal et al., 2017), 文本VQA, TextVQA(Singh et al., 2019)、MMVet, and MMVet(Yu et al., 2023)。此外，为了进一步证明我们方法的稳健性，我们提供了 LLaVA-Bench (LLaVA-B) 的补充评估. Additionally, to further demonstrate the robustness of our approach, we provide supplementary evaluations on LLaVA-Bench (LLaVA-B)(Liu et al., 2023b), 维兹维兹, VizWiz(Gurari et al., 2018), MMBench-中文 (MMB-CN), MMBench-Chinese (MMB-CN)(Liu et al., 2024d)和 SEED 工作台 (SEED), and SEED-Bench (SEED)(Li et al., 2023a)在附录中。 此外，为了验证我们的修剪方法是否保持in the appendix. Furthermore, to verify that our pruning method maintains时间推理和视频理解temporal reasoning and video comprehension功能，我们根据三个标准视频基准进行评估： TGIFcapabilities, we evaluate on three standard video benchmarks: TGIF(Li et al., 2016),MSVD, MSVD(Chen and Dolan, 2011)和 MSRVTT, and MSRVTT(Xu et al., 2016)。 除非另有说明，我们按照官方评估协议报告准确性，以确保公平比较。. Unless otherwise specified, we report accuracy following the official evaluation protocols to ensure a fair comparison.

GQA。GQA.

质量保证局GQA(Hudson and Manning, 2019)评估场景理解和构图推理。它基于图像、结构化场景图和旨在探测细粒度对象属性、空间关系和多步骤推理的问题。 GQA 由视觉基因组数据集生成，包含约 113K 图像中超过 2200 万个问题。 GQA 的一个关键特征是严格平衡每个问题组的答案分布，这显着减轻了语言先验，并迫使模型依赖视觉证据而不是统计相关性。在模型压缩的背景下，GQA 提供了模型对复杂视觉场景进行联合感知和推理的能力的诊断视图，作为在修剪后保留多跳推理能力的压力测试。evaluates scene understanding and compositional reasoning. It is built upon images, structured scene graphs, and questions designed to probe fine-grained object attributes, spatial relations, and multi-step reasoning. Generated from the Visual Genome dataset, GQA contains over 22 million questions across approximately 113K images. A key characteristic of GQA is its rigorous balancing of the answer distribution for each question group, which significantly mitigates language priors and forces models to rely on visual evidence rather than statistical correlations. In the context of model compression, GQA provides a diagnostic view of a model’s ability to jointly perceive and reason over complex visual scenes, serving as a stress test for preserving multi-hop reasoning capabilities after pruning.

MMBench。MMBench.

MMBench (Liu et al., 2024d)提供了按三级能力层次结构组织的多维评估框架。 Level-1针对感知和推理两大核心能力； 2 级将这些扩展为六个子能力； Level-3将考核进一步细化为20个细粒度的能力维度。 MMBench 由各种来源构建而成，包含大约 3,000 个涵盖不同领域的多项选择题。 MMBench 的一个显着特征是它的 CircularEval 策略，它将同一问题多次输入到模型中，但选项会发生变化。这种机制有效地降低了模型对选项排序和随机猜测的敏感性。对于 VLM 修剪，MMBench 是验证压缩模型在广泛的任务中保持强大的指令跟踪和推理能力的关键基准，而不是过度拟合特定模式。provides a multi-dimensional evaluation framework organized in a three-level hierarchy of capabilities. Level-1 targets the two core abilities of perception and reasoning; Level-2 expands these into six sub-abilities; and Level-3 further refines the assessment into 20 fine-grained ability dimensions. Constructed from various sources, MMBench contains approximately 3,000 multiple-choice questions covering diverse domains. A distinguishing feature of MMBench is its CircularEval strategy, which inputs the same question with shifted options multiple times to the model. This mechanism effectively mitigates the model’s sensitivity to option ordering and random guessing. For VLM pruning, MMBench serves as a critical benchmark to verify that the compressed model maintains robust instruction-following and reasoning capabilities across a broad spectrum of tasks, rather than overfitting to specific patterns.

女士。MME.

微机电系统MME(Fu et al., 2025)是一个全面的定量基准，旨在评估 14 个不同子任务的多模式法学硕士。这些子任务在结构上分为两个主轴：感知（is a comprehensive and quantitative benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal LLMs across 14 distinct subtasks. These subtasks are structurally categorized into two primary axes: Perception (例如e.g.、粗粒度识别、OCR、颜色）和认知（, coarse-grained recognition, OCR, color) and Cognition (例如e.g.、常识推理、数值计算）。 MME 采用简洁的指令-答案对，主要采用“是/否”格式，以最大限度地减少即时工程的影响并减少潜在的数据泄漏。通过手动注释的样本，它有助于可靠地测量多模式性能。对于修剪研究，MME 对于诊断参数减少是否不成比例地影响基本视觉感知或高阶认知推理特别有用。, commonsense reasoning, numerical calculation). MME employs concise instruction–answer pairs, predominantly in a "Yes/No" format, to minimize the influence of prompt engineering and reduce potential data leakage. With manually annotated samples, it facilitates a reliable measurement of multimodal performance. For pruning studies, MME is particularly useful for diagnosing whether parameter reduction disproportionately impacts basic visual perception or higher-order cognitive reasoning.

教皇。POPE.

教皇POPE(Li et al., 2023c)是一个专注于评估 VLM 中物体幻觉的专门基准。它将幻觉评估重新表述为一系列有关图像中特定对象是否存在的二元“是/否”问题（基于 MSCOCO 验证集）。至关重要的是，POPE 在三种不同的采样设置下评估模型，以将视觉感知与语言先验分开：随机（图像中没有的对象）、流行（数据集中的频繁对象）和对抗（经常与当前对象同时出现但不存在的对象）。通过报告这些设置的准确度、召回率、精确度和 F1，POPE 提供了幻觉倾向的可靠量化。对于修剪后的模型，在对抗性设置上保持高性能是一个强有力的指标，表明压缩并未损害模型在实际视觉证据中得出答案的能力。is a specialized benchmark focusing on evaluating object hallucination in VLMs. It reformulates hallucination assessment as a series of binary "Yes/No" questions about the presence of specific objects in an image (based on MSCOCO validation sets). Crucially, POPE evaluates models under three distinct sampling settings to disentangle visual perception from language priors: Random (objects not in the image), Popular (frequent objects in the dataset), and Adversarial (objects that often co-occur with present objects but are absent). By reporting Accuracy, Recall, Precision, and F1 across these settings, POPE provides a robust quantification of hallucination tendencies. For pruned models, maintaining high performance on the Adversarial setting is a strong indicator that the compression has not compromised the model’s ability to ground answers in actual visual evidence.

科学质量保证。ScienceQA.

科学质量保证ScienceQA(Lu et al., 2022)涵盖了广泛的领域，包括自然科学、社会科学和语言科学。问题按层次分为26个主题、127个类别和379个技能，为评估多模态理解和多步推理提供了多样化和全面的测试平台。与众不同的是，ScienceQA 包括带注释的讲座和解释，有助于评估思想链 (CoT) 能力。在 VLM 剪枝的背景下，ScienceQA 对于评估压缩模型是否保留特定领域知识和执行可解释推理的能力至关重要，确保参数减少不会损害模型处理复杂、知识密集型任务的能力。spans a wide array of domains, including natural, social, and language sciences. Questions are hierarchically categorized into 26 topics, 127 categories, and 379 skills, providing a diverse and comprehensive testbed for evaluating multimodal understanding and multi-step reasoning. Distinctively, ScienceQA includes annotated lectures and explanations, facilitating the assessment of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) capabilities. In the context of VLM pruning, ScienceQA is essential for evaluating whether the compressed model retains domain-specific knowledge and the ability to perform interpretable reasoning, ensuring that parameter reduction does not compromise the model’s capacity to handle complex, knowledge-intensive tasks.

VQAv2。VQAv2.

VQAv2 (Goyal et al., 2017)是一个标准的开放式 VQA 基准，涵盖来自 MS COCO 数据集的各种现实世界图像和问题。 VQAv2 的一个关键功能是其设计通过平衡对来最大限度地减少语言偏差：对于每个问题，数据集都包含互补图像，这些图像会产生不同的答案（is a standard open-ended VQA benchmark covering diverse real-world images and questions derived from the MS COCO dataset. A critical feature of VQAv2 is its design to minimize language bias through balanced pairs: for every question, the dataset includes complementary images that result in different answers (例如e.g.，“是”与“否”）。这种结构迫使模型依赖视觉证据，而不是利用统计语言相关性。 VQAv2 拥有超过 110 万个问题，每个问题都有多个人工注释，可作为一般视觉问答的大规模测试平台。对于修剪，它提供了一个基本基线，以确保压缩模型保留广义视觉识别功能并将视觉特征与文本查询正确对齐。, "Yes" vs. "No"). This structure compels the model to rely on visual evidence rather than exploiting statistical language correlations. With over 1.1 million questions and multiple human annotations per question, VQAv2 serves as a large-scale testbed for general visual question answering. For pruning, it provides a fundamental baseline to ensure that the compressed model retains generalized visual recognition capabilities and aligns visual features correctly with textual queries.

文本VQA。TextVQA.

文本VQATextVQA(Singh et al., 2019)评估图像中嵌入文本的推理，解决一般 VQA 基准测试经常忽视的特定功能。它基于开放图像数据集的图像构建，包含 45,336 个问题，需要模型检测、识别和推理不同场景中出现的文本（evaluates reasoning over embedded text in images, addressing a specific capability often overlooked by general VQA benchmarks. Built upon images from the Open Images dataset, it comprises 45,336 questions that require the model to detect, recognize, and reason about text appearing in diverse scenes (例如e.g.、招牌、书籍封面）。成功的性能需要光学字符识别 (OCR) 和语义推理的紧密集成，因为模型通常必须从图像中转录特定的文本字符串来制定答案。对于 VLM 修剪，TextVQA 作为细粒度特征保留的严格测试，验证压缩模型是否保留足够的分辨率和局部注意力来处理小型、符号丰富的视觉元素而不会降级。, signboards, book covers). Successful performance demands a tight integration of optical character recognition (OCR) and semantic reasoning, as the model must often transcribe specific text strings from the image to formulate the answer. For VLM pruning, TextVQA serves as a rigorous test of fine-grained feature preservation, verifying that the compressed model retains sufficient resolution and local attention to process small, symbol-rich visual elements without degradation.

MM-兽医。MM-Vet.

MM-兽医MM-Vet(Yu et al., 2023)通过定义六种核心视觉语言能力来解决复杂的多模式问题：识别、知识、OCR、空间意识、语言生成和数学。除了单独测试这些功能之外，MM-Vet 还评估了这些功能的 16 种不同集成（targets complex multimodal problem solving by defining six core vision–language capabilities: Recognition, Knowledge, OCR, Spatial Awareness, Language Generation, and Math. Beyond testing these in isolation, MM-Vet evaluates 16 distinct integrations of these capabilities (例如e.g.，识别一个物体，然后回答有关它的基于知识的问题）。该基准采用基于 LLM 的评估系统（通常是 GPT-4）对开放式回答进行评分，提供了严格的字符串匹配指标所缺乏的细微差别。对于剪枝，MM-Vet 有助于验证压缩模型保留链接多个推理步骤所需的协同作用，确保参数的删除不会切断不同认知模块之间的功能连接。, recognizing an object and then answering a knowledge-based question about it). The benchmark employs an LLM-based evaluation system (typically GPT-4) to score open-ended responses, offering a nuance that rigid string-matching metrics lack. For pruning, MM-Vet is instrumental in verifying that the compressed model retains the synergy required to chain multiple reasoning steps, ensuring that the removal of parameters does not sever the functional connections between different cognitive modules.

LLaVA-长凳。LLaVA-Bench.

LLaVA-长凳LLaVA-Bench(Liu et al., 2023b)旨在评估 MLLM 在现实场景中处理复杂、开放式视觉指令的能力。它由一组不同的“野外”图像和详细查询组成，依靠 GPT-4 作为公正的法官，根据参考答案对模型生成的响应进行评分。与标准客观基准不同，LLaVA-Bench 捕捉了对话流畅性、帮助性和视觉基础的细微差别。在令牌修剪的背景下，验证积极的视觉压缩不会降低模型丰富、自由形式的多模态生成的能力及其对不可预测的人类指令的遵守至关重要。is designed to evaluate the capability of MLLMs in handling complex, open-ended visual instructions in real-world scenarios. Comprising a diverse set of “in-the-wild” images and detailed queries, it relies on GPT-4 as an impartial judge to score the model’s generated responses against reference answers. Unlike standard objective benchmarks, LLaVA-Bench captures the nuances of conversational fluency, helpfulness, and visual grounding. In the context of token pruning, it is crucial for verifying that aggressive visual compression does not degrade the model’s capacity for rich, free-form multimodal generation and its adherence to unpredictable human instructions.

维兹维兹。VizWiz.

维兹维兹VizWiz(Gurari et al., 2018)源自盲人和视障人士提出的真实视觉问题。因此，该数据集的特点是图像具有严重的现实世界噪声，例如照明不良、模糊和遮挡，以及偶尔无法回答的查询。该基准测试严格测试模型在次优视觉条件下的稳健性和零样本泛化能力。对于 VLM 修剪，VizWiz 充当独特的诊断工具：它评估当视觉线索本质上稀缺或扭曲时修剪算法是否保持稳健，确保令牌减少过程不会不成比例地丢弃关键的、尽管有噪声的视觉信息。originates from authentic visual questions asked by blind and visually impaired individuals. Consequently, the dataset is characterized by images with severe real-world noise, such as poor lighting, blurriness, and occlusions, coupled with occasionally unanswerable queries. This benchmark rigorously tests a model’s robustness and zero-shot generalization under suboptimal visual conditions. For VLM pruning, VizWiz serves as a unique diagnostic tool: it assesses whether the pruning algorithm remains robust when visual cues are inherently scarce or distorted, ensuring that the token reduction process does not disproportionately discard critical, albeit noisy, visual information.

MMBench-中文。MMBench-Chinese.

MMBench-中文 (MMB-CN)MMBench-Chinese (MMB-CN)(Liu et al., 2024d)是MMBench评估框架的双语延伸，将严谨、多维度的评估转化为中文语言环境。它保留了 CircularEval 策略来减轻选项选择偏差，它评估相同广泛的感知和推理能力，但从根本上需要强大的跨语言对齐。在我们的剪枝研究中，MMB-CN 用于确认类自适应层融合和标记减少机制在不同的语言空间中有效地泛化，确保在非英语语言中评估时跨模态语义对齐不会在结构上受到损害。is the bilingual extension of the MMBench evaluation framework, translating the rigorous, multi-dimensional assessment into the Chinese linguistic context. Retaining the CircularEval strategy to mitigate option-selection bias, it evaluates the same broad spectrum of perception and reasoning capabilities but fundamentally requires robust cross-lingual alignment. Within our pruning study, MMB-CN is utilized to confirm that the class-adaptive layer fusion and token reduction mechanisms generalize effectively across diverse linguistic spaces, ensuring that cross-modal semantic alignment is not structurally impaired when evaluated in non-English languages.

种子工作台。SEED-Bench.

SEED-工作台SEED-Bench(Li et al., 2023a)是一个全面的多模式基准，专门用于评估细粒度的视觉理解和空间推理。它包含数千个多项选择题，以及精心设计的干扰项，针对特定维度，如对象属性、实例位置和空间关系。这些查询的精确性质迫使模型依赖于精确的视觉证据，而不是整体语义猜测。在评估修剪后的 MLLM 时，SEED-Bench 充当细粒度令牌保留的严格压力测试；它揭示了我们的双阶段修剪策略是否成功地保留了区分微妙的、误导性的选项所需的关键的、高度本地化的视觉标记。is a comprehensive multimodal benchmark specifically designed to evaluate fine-grained visual understanding and spatial reasoning. It comprises thousands of multiple-choice questions with meticulously crafted distractors, targeting specific dimensions such as object attributes, instance locations, and spatial relations. The precise nature of these queries forces models to rely on exact visual evidence rather than holistic semantic guessing. In the evaluation of pruned MLLMs, SEED-Bench acts as a stringent stress test for fine-grained token retention; it reveals whether our dual-stage pruning strategy successfully preserves the crucial, highly localized visual tokens required to distinguish between subtle, misleading options.

TGIF。TGIF.

TGIF (Li et al., 2016)是一个专注于动画 GIF 的数据集，它捕获运动语义和时间动态。它包含超过 10 万张来自社交媒体的动画图像，并配有自然语言描述。与静态图像数据集不同，TGIF 要求模型推理随时间变化的动作、重复和状态转换。在 VLM 剪枝的背景下，TGIF 作为评估压缩模型是否保留的关键基准is a dataset focusing on animated GIFs, which captures motion semantics and temporal dynamics. It contains over 100K animated images sourced from social media, paired with natural language descriptions. Unlike static image datasets, TGIF challenges models to reason about actions, repetitions, and state transitions over time. In the context of VLM pruning, TGIF serves as a critical benchmark to assess whether the compressed model preserves时间一致性temporal consistency。由于修剪通常涉及减少视觉标记中的冗余，因此 TGIF 上的性能表明该方法是否有效地区分基本运动线索和冗余背景帧。. Since pruning often involves reducing redundancy in visual tokens, performance on TGIF indicates whether the method effectively distinguishes between essential motion cues and redundant background frames.

MSVD。MSVD.

MSVD (Chen and Dolan, 2011)构成视频问答的基本基准，由从 YouTube 收集的约 1,970 个短视频片段组成。与字幕任务不同，MSVD 要求模型基于时空推理为有关视频内容的问题提供精确的答案。对于修剪研究，MSVD 充当基线敏感性测试。这里的高性能确保模型参数的减少不会破坏时空视觉特征和语言解码器之间的基本对齐，作为一般视频到文本对齐的健全性检查。我们按照官方评估协议报告准确性，以确保与其他视频基准的一致性。constitutes a fundamental benchmark for video question answering, consisting of approximately 1,970 short video clips collected from YouTube. Unlike the captioning task, MSVD requires the model to provide precise answers to questions regarding video content based on spatio-temporal reasoning. For pruning studies, MSVD acts as a baseline sensitivity test. High performance here ensures that the reduction in model parameters has not destroyed the basic alignment between spatio-temporal visual features and the language decoder, serving as a sanity check for general video-to-text alignment. We report the accuracy following the official evaluation protocol to ensure consistency with other video benchmarks.

MSRVTT。MSRVTT.

右心室舒张时间MSRVTT(Xu et al., 2016)是一个专为开放域视频问答而设计的数据集，包含 10,000 个视频剪辑，分为 20 个不同的类别（is a dataset designed for open-domain video question answering, containing 10,000 video clips categorized into 20 distinct classes (例如e.g.、音乐、体育、新闻）。这种多样性要求模型能够处理广泛的词汇量和复杂的视觉场景，以回答有关细粒度事件的问题。在模型压缩的背景下，MSRVTT 对于诊断视频领域的“灾难性遗忘”特别有用。在 MSRVTT 上保持高精度意味着修剪后的模型保留了跨不同类别的稳健特征表示，并且不会过度拟合特定的视觉模式。与官方设置一致，我们将准确性作为主要指标。, music, sports, news). This diversity requires models to handle a wide vocabulary and complex visual scenes to answer questions regarding fine-grained events. In the context of model compression, MSRVTT is particularly useful for diagnosing "catastrophic forgetting" in the video domain. Maintaining high accuracy on MSRVTT implies that the pruned model retains robust feature representations across diverse categories and is not overfitting to specific visual patterns. Consistent with the official settings, we report accuracy as the primary metric.

模型。Models.

我们在几个代表性的基础上实例化并评估 CLASPWe instantiate and evaluate CLASP on top of several representative开源open-source多模态大语言模型（MLLM）。对于multimodal large language models (MLLMs). For图像理解image understanding，我们主要构建于 LLaVA 系列，包括标准 LLaVA-1.5, we primarily build on the LLaVA family, including the standard LLaVA-1.5(Liu et al., 2024a)以及更强的 LLaVA-NeXTand the stronger LLaVA-NeXT(Liu et al., 2024b)。我们特别采用LLaVA-NeXT来验证下的性能. We specifically adopt LLaVA-NeXT to validate performance under高分辨率high-resolution视觉输入，遵循官方推理设置。为了证明我们的方法在不同架构中的泛化性，我们进一步包括 Qwen2.5-VLvisual inputs, following the official inference settings. To demonstrate the generalization of our method across different architectures, we further include Qwen2.5-VL(Bai et al., 2025)。作为最先进的模型，它引入了朴素动态分辨率机制来处理任意纵横比，作为我们对可变长度视觉标记的修剪策略的严格测试平台。最后，评估能力. As a state-of-the-art model, it introduces Naive Dynamic Resolution mechanisms to handle arbitrary aspect ratios, serving as a rigorous testbed for our pruning strategy on variable-length visual tokens. Finally, to assess capabilities in the时域temporal domain，我们将评估扩展到 Video-LLaVA, we extend our evaluation to Video-LLaVA(Lin et al., 2024)。该模型统一了图像和视频特征对齐，使我们能够验证是否. This model unifies image and video feature alignment, allowing us to verify whether扣环CLASP可以有效减少时间冗余而不影响运动理解。can effectively reduce temporal redundancies without compromising motion understanding.

给我。ToMe.

给我ToMe(Bolya et al., 2022)通过使用轻量级令牌匹配在转换器层中合并相似的令牌来加速视觉转换器。与丢弃“不重要”标记的传统修剪方法不同，ToMe 采用基于特征相似性（通常使用 Key 或 Query 投影）的二分匹配算法来识别冗余标记。然后，它通过加权平均聚合这些令牌，逐渐减少整个网络深度的序列长度。由于不需要额外的参数或重新训练，ToMe 可作为高效、即插即用的基线，用于评估 VLM 视觉编码器中的推理速度和信息保存之间的权衡。accelerates vision transformers by merging similar tokens within transformer layers using lightweight token matching. Unlike traditional pruning methods that discard "unimportant" tokens, ToMe employs a bipartite matching algorithm based on feature similarity (typically using the Key or Query projections) to identify redundant tokens. It then aggregates these tokens via weighted averaging, progressively reducing the sequence length across the network depth. Since it requires no additional parameters or retraining, ToMe serves as a highly efficient, plug-and-play baseline for evaluating the trade-off between inference speed and information preservation in the VLM’s visual encoder.

LLaVA-PruMerge。LLaVA-PruMerge.

LLaVA-PruMerge (Shang et al., 2025)引入了一种自适应混合策略，结合了修剪和合并的优点。它首先根据从特殊 [CLS] 标记到图像补丁的注意力分数来评估视觉标记的重要性，从而有效地识别与全局语义上下文最相关的区域。基于这些分数，该方法将标记划分为子集：直接修剪重要性分数较低的标记以消除背景噪声，而高度相关的前景标记则根据关键相似度进行合并。这种方法显着减少了视觉编码器的序列长度，无需重新训练，确保保留关键的视觉细节，同时在令牌进入 LLM 之前有效消除空间冗余。introduces an adaptive hybrid strategy that combines the benefits of both pruning and merging. It first evaluates the importance of visual tokens based on the attention scores from the special [CLS] token to image patches, effectively identifying regions most relevant to the global semantic context. Based on these scores, the method divides tokens into subsets: tokens with low importance scores are directly pruned to remove background noise, while highly correlated foreground tokens are merged based on key similarity. This approach significantly reduces the sequence length of the visual encoder without retraining, ensuring that critical visual details are preserved while spatial redundancy is efficiently eliminated before the tokens enter the LLM.

快V。FastV.

快VFastV(Chen et al., 2024a)识别大型语言模型 (LLM) 中视觉标记的低效率并执行早期标记修剪。它基于这样的观察：虽然视觉标记在初始变压器层中至关重要，但更深层次的注意力机制往往会忽略其中的绝大多数。利用这一点，FastV 根据早期层的平均注意力权重对视觉标记进行排名（identifies the inefficiency of visual tokens within Large Language Models (LLMs) and performs early-stage token pruning. It is grounded in the observation that while visual tokens are crucial in the initial transformer layers, the attention mechanism in deeper layers tends to ignore the vast majority of them. Leveraging this, FastV ranks visual tokens based on their average attention weights in the early layers (例如e.g.，第二层）并丢弃所有后续层中最不重要的层。该策略显着减少了推理期间的 KV 缓存内存占用和 FLOP，使模型能够保持高性能，同时在计算量大的深层中处理更少的令牌。, the second layer) and discards the least significant ones for all subsequent layers. This strategy significantly reduces the KV-cache memory footprint and FLOPs during inference, allowing the model to maintain high performance while processing significantly fewer tokens in the computation-heavy deep layers.

嗨，红色。HiRED.

嗨红HiRED(Arif et al., 2025)引入了一种空间感知修剪策略，旨在缓解全局排名方法中经常观察到的“隧道视野”问题。 HiRED 不是在单个池中竞争所有视觉标记，而是将图像划分为空间分区。然后，它根据 [CLS] 代币的注意力分布，动态地将特定的代币预算分配给每个分区。通过在这些本地化预算中选择信息最丰富的标记，HiRED 可确保修剪后的模型在整个图像中保持广泛的空间覆盖。这种分层方法允许进行积极的压缩，同时防止完全抑制背景区域或次要对象，这对于需要整体场景理解的任务至关重要。introduces a spatially-aware pruning strategy designed to mitigate the "tunnel vision" problem often observed in global ranking methods. Instead of competing all visual tokens in a single pool, HiRED divides the image into spatial partitions. It then dynamically allocates a specific token budget to each partition based on the attention distribution of the [CLS] token. By selecting the most informative tokens within these localized budgets, HiRED ensures that the pruned model maintains broad spatial coverage across the image. This hierarchical approach allows for aggressive compression while preventing the complete suppression of background regions or secondary objects, which are essential for tasks requiring holistic scene understanding.

PD 滴。PDrop.

普罗普PDrop(Xing et al., 2024)或 PyramidDrop，实现了一种渐进式修剪策略，模仿标准 Vision Transformer 中 CNN 的层次结构。 PDrop 不是在整个编码器中保持恒定的序列长度，而是根据注意力重要性分数大幅减少特定中间层的标记计数。这构建了一个“金字塔状”的信息流，其中高分辨率细节在浅层中处理，而仅保留语义上最显着的标记用于计算量大的深层。通过有效地汇集视觉信息，PDrop 显着减少了 FLOP 和延迟，成为结构修剪方法的代表性基线。, or PyramidDrop, implements a progressive pruning strategy that mimics the hierarchical structure of CNNs within a standard Vision Transformer. Instead of maintaining a constant sequence length throughout the encoder, PDrop drastically reduces the token count at specific intermediate layers based on attention importance scores. This constructs a "pyramid-like" information flow, where high-resolution details are processed in shallow layers, while only the most semantically salient tokens are retained for the computation-heavy deep layers. By effectively funneling visual information, PDrop achieves a significant reduction in FLOPs and latency, serving as a representative baseline for structural pruning methods.

多阶段视觉代币掉落（MustDrop）。Multi-Stage Vision Token Dropping (MustDrop).

多阶段视觉代币掉落Multi-Stage Vision Token Dropping(Liu et al., 2024c)在视觉编码器中采用渐进式压缩策略来优化计算效率。它不是执行单步缩减，而是根据注意力重要性或学习策略在多个中间层（阶段）执行令牌丢弃。这种分层方法允许模型在浅层阶段保留细粒度的低级细节，同时积极减少更深、更多语义层中的空间冗余。因此，它显着降低了视觉主干的 FLOP，并最大限度地减少了传递给多模态投影仪的序列长度，从而在推理速度和任务性能之间实现了良好的平衡。adopts a progressive compression strategy within the vision encoder to optimize computational efficiency. Instead of performing a single-step reduction, it executes token dropping at multiple intermediate layers (stages) based on attention significance or learned policies. This hierarchical approach allows the model to retain fine-grained low-level details in the shallow stages while aggressively reducing spatial redundancy in the deeper, more semantic layers. Consequently, it significantly lowers the FLOPs of the vision backbone and minimizes the sequence length passed to the multimodal projector, achieving a favorable balance between inference speed and task performance.

稀疏VLM。SparseVLM.

稀疏VLMSparseVLM(Zhang et al., 2024b)提出了一个超越单模态视觉显着性的动态修剪框架。它使用跨模式注意力对标记重要性进行排名，确保根据视觉标记与特定文本查询或指令的相关性来保留视觉标记。认识到不同的图像包含不同数量的信息，SparseVLM 引入了自适应稀疏率，动态调整每个输入的令牌预算。此外，为了减轻积极修剪的风险，它提出了一种新颖的代币回收机制。该机制不是永久丢弃修剪的令牌，而是聚合或缓冲它们，允许模型在必要时从这些“丢弃”区域检索上下文。这显着提高了不同输入复杂性下的效率，而不会影响视觉表示的语义完整性。presents a dynamic pruning framework that goes beyond uni-modal visual salience. It ranks token importance using cross-modal attention, ensuring that visual tokens are preserved based on their relevance to the specific textual query or instruction. Recognizing that different images contain varying amounts of information, SparseVLM introduces adaptive sparsity ratios, dynamically adjusting the token budget for each input. Furthermore, to mitigate the risks of aggressive pruning, it proposes a novel token recycling mechanism. Instead of permanently discarding pruned tokens, this mechanism aggregates or buffers them, allowing the model to retrieve context from these "discarded" regions if necessary. This significantly improves efficiency under varying input complexity without compromising the semantic integrity of the visual representation.

愿景压缩。VisionZip.

视觉压缩VisionZip(Yang et al., 2025)解决了基于注意力的剪枝方法中经常出现的空间冗余问题。虽然标准方法只是选择顶部addresses the spatial redundancy problem often found in attention-based pruning methods. While standard approaches simply select the top-kkVisionZip 观察到，这些高分标记往往聚集在同一视觉对象周围，从而导致重复信息。 为了缓解这个问题，它实现了一个两步管道：首先，它通过编码器注意力来评估标记显着性以滤除背景噪声；其次，它根据关键相似性对剩余的高显着性标记进行聚类。 通过从这些簇中选择代表性标记，VisionZip 确保最终压缩序列保持高度语义多样性，覆盖图像内的各种不同对象和区域，以进行下游多模态推理。tokens with the highest attention scores, VisionZip observes that these high-scoring tokens tend to cluster around the same visual object, leading to repetitive information. To mitigate this, it implements a two-step pipeline: first, it evaluates token saliency via encoder attention to filter out background noise; second, it clusters the remaining high-saliency tokens based on key similarity. By selecting representative tokens from these clusters, VisionZip ensures that the final compressed sequence maintains high semantic diversity, covering various distinct objects and regions within the image for downstream multimodal reasoning.

飞镖。DART.

飞镖DART(Wen et al., 2025b)提出了一种 Duplication-Aware Reduction Transformer 策略，旨在最大限度地提高信息多样性，同时保持硬件效率。与可能选择冗余高范数标记的基于量值的方法不同，DART 显式过滤掉冗余。它通过选择一小组“枢轴”标记并计算这些枢轴和其余标记之间的余弦相似度来进行操作。具有高相似性（高重复性）的标记被丢弃，确保保留的集合覆盖广泛的语义范围。至关重要的是，DART 的设计与 FlashAttention 和其他高效的注意力算子兼容。通过避免复杂的聚集-分散操作或不规则的内存访问模式，它可以确保理论上的 FLOP 减少直接转化为推理过程中显着的挂钟加速。proposes a Duplication-Aware Reduction Transformer strategy designed to maximize information diversity while maintaining hardware efficiency. Unlike magnitude-based methods that may select redundant high-norm tokens, DART explicitly filters out redundancy. It operates by selecting a small set of "pivot" tokens and computing the cosine similarity between these pivots and the remaining tokens. Tokens with high similarity (high duplication) are discarded, ensuring that the retained set covers a broad semantic range. Crucially, DART is designed to be compatible with FlashAttention and other efficient attention operators. By avoiding complex gather-scatter operations or irregular memory access patterns, it ensures that the theoretical reduction in FLOPs translates directly into significant wall-clock speedups during inference.

实施细节。Implementation details.

对于基于图像的基准测试，我们使用官方 LLaVA 实现进行实验。对于视频基准测试，我们按照官方 LLaVA-NeXT 代码库构建模型，并通过以下方式进行评估For image-based benchmarks, we run experiments using the official LLaVA implementation. For video benchmarks, we build the model following the official LLaVA-NeXT codebase and conduct evaluation vialmms-评估lmms-eval。对于更新的 VLM 架构（. For more recent VLM architectures (例如e.g.，Qwen2.5-VL），我们依靠, Qwen2.5-VL), we rely onVLME验证套件VLMEvalKit作为评估工具包。所有推理评估均在 NVIDIA A100 (80GB) GPU 上执行。为了确保可重复性，我们在下面详细介绍了数据集构建、参数验证和特定于模型的架构的具体配置。as the evaluation toolkit. All inference evaluations were executed on NVIDIA A100 (80GB) GPUs. To ensure reproducibility, we detail the specific configurations for dataset construction, parameter validation, and model-specific architectures below.

数据集分类和意图映射。Dataset Categorization and Intent Mapping.为了实现类别自适应路由，我们使用 Qwen3-8B 模型构建了一个分类数据集来识别视觉问答意图。我们设计了一个系统提示，定义了 15 个细粒度的意图（To enable class-adaptive routing, we constructed a categorized dataset using the Qwen3-8B model to identify visual question answering intents. We designed a system prompt defining 15 fine-grained intents (例如e.g., 算术推理arithmetic reasoning, 时间顺序temporal order）并指示模型以严格的 JSON 格式输出分类。为了增强鲁棒性，我们应用了确定性启发式覆盖（) and instructed the model to output classifications in a strict JSON format. To enhance robustness, we applied deterministic heuristic overrides (例如e.g.，将“who write”之类的关键字映射到, mapping keywords like “who wrote” to文本/符号识别Text/Symbol Recognition）。这些标签被合并为 9 个核心类别（表). These labels were merged into the 9 core categories (Table6）以确保路由有足够的样本密度。) to ensure sufficient sample density for routing.

超参数搜索和优化。Hyperparameter Search and Optimization.为了确定最佳融合权重和修剪比率，我们采用了To determine the optimal fusion weights and pruning ratios, we employed the离散子空间搜索算法Discrete Subspace Search Algorithm详见附录detailed in AppendixB。具体来说，我们在每个类别 2,000 个样本的平衡数据集上执行了此校准。尽管完全不受约束的基于梯度的优化可能存在对有限校准数据过度拟合的风险，但我们发现我们的方法（将搜索空间限制为离散的、语义上有意义的层原型）有效地防止了这种过度拟合。至关重要的是，我们的实验表明，这. Specifically, we performed this calibration on a balanced dataset of 2,000 samples per category. Although fully unconstrained gradient-based optimization can risk overfitting on limited calibration data, we found that our approach—which restricts the search space to discrete, semantically meaningful layer prototypes—effectively prevents such overfitting. Crucially, our experiments indicated that this数据驱动校准data-driven calibration与特定任务的手动启发法相比，产生了卓越的零样本泛化。通过自动适应每个意图所需的视觉抽象级别（例如，平衡细粒度细节和高级语义），搜索算法可以识别更稳健的配置。因此，本文报告的所有结果均利用通过此搜索过程获得的校准配置，如表中所示yielded superior zero-shot generalization compared to task-specific manual heuristics. By automatically adapting to the level of visual abstraction required for each intent (e.g., balancing fine-grained details and high-level semantics), the search algorithm identifies more robust configurations. Consequently, all results reported in this paper utilize the calibrated configurations obtained via this search process, as provided in Table6.

核心部件的消融。Ablation of Core Components.

为了隔离和量化我们提出的模块的单独贡献，我们在固定保留预算下对 LLaVA-v1.5-7B 进行了组件式消融研究To isolate and quantify the individual contributions of our proposed modules, we conduct a component-wise ablation study on LLaVA-v1.5-7B under a fixed retention budget ofR=192R=192。 表. Table10展示了基线剪枝模型、仅使用类自适应层融合 (+Fusion) 增强的模型、仅利用类别相关分割比 (+Ratio) 的模型以及结合两者 (+Both) 的完整 CLASP 框架的性能。presents the performance of the baseline pruning model, the model augmented solely with Class-Adaptive Layer Fusion (+Fusion), the model utilizing only the Category-Dependent Split Ratio (+Ratio), and the complete CLASP framework combining both (+Both).

结果表明，每个组件独立地提供了相对于基线的稳健改进。 引入类自适应层融合会产生巨大的收益（The results demonstrate that each component independently provides robust improvements over the baseline. Introducing the class-adaptive layer fusion yields substantial gains (例如e.g., +93+93MME 上的点和points on MME and+2.0+2.0在 GQA 上），强调了将视觉抽象深度与用户意图动态匹配的至关重要性。 同样，根据提示类别（+比率）调整相关性覆盖修剪预算可以持续提高所有任务的性能。 最终，两个组件的集成实现了所有指标的最高准确度（on GQA), highlighting the critical importance of dynamically matching the visual abstraction depth to the user’s intent. Similarly, adjusting the relevance-coverage pruning budget based on the prompt category (+Ratio) consistently boosts performance across all tasks. Ultimately, the integration of both components achieves the highest accuracy across all metrics (例如e.g.，MME达到1848，GQA达到60.4），证明最优视觉表示提取和自适应预算分配是高度互补的。, MME reaching 1848 and GQA reaching 60.4), proving that optimal visual representation extraction and adaptive budget allocation are highly complementary.

不同基准的剪枝比率的敏感性分析。Sensitivity analysis of pruning ratios across diverse benchmarks.

图Figure4提供不同程度的剪枝率（范围从provides a comprehensive visualization of performance trajectories under varying degrees of pruning ratio (ranging from0%0\% to 95%95\%）。 我们将我们提出的方法与两个代表性的最先进基线进行比较：SparseVLM 和 PDrop。 从这些结果中可以得出三个关键观察结果。 首先，我们的方法（橙色线）始终形成所有八个不同评估套件的性能曲线的上包络，与基线相比，展示了卓越的令牌保留能力。 其次，我们观察到一种优雅退化的现象：而竞争方法，特别是 PDrop（绿色），在高剪枝机制（剪枝率）下遭受灾难性的性能崩溃。). We compare our proposed method against two representative state-of-the-art baselines: SparseVLM and PDrop. Three key observations can be drawn from these results. First, our method (orange line) consistently forms the upper envelope of the performance curves across all eight distinct evaluation suites, demonstrating superior token retention capabilities compared to the baselines. Second, we observe a phenomenon of graceful degradation: while competing methods, particularly PDrop (green), suffer from catastrophic performance collapse in the high-pruning regime (pruning ratio>0.75>0.75），我们的方法保持了非常强大的功效。 例如，在 MME 和 GQA 基准测试中，即使丢弃), our approach maintains remarkably robust efficacy. For instance, on the MME and GQA benchmarks, even when discarding95%95\%对于视觉标记，我们的方法保留了很大一部分未修剪的基线精度，而 PDrop 的性能严重下降。 第三，在 MMVet（请注意，该基准测试无法获得 PDrop 结果）和 SQA 等具有挑战性的推理任务中，我们的方法表现出高弹性，随着压缩率的增加，显着扩大了与 SparseVLM 的性能差距。 这些发现证实，我们基于相似性的选择策略有效地隔离和保留了语义关键的视觉区域，即使在极端的计算限制下也能确保模型的可靠性。of visual tokens, our method retains a significant portion of the unpruned baseline accuracy, whereas PDrop approaches severely degraded performance. Third, in challenging reasoning tasks such as MMVet (note that PDrop results are unavailable for this benchmark) and SQA, our method exhibits high resilience, significantly widening the performance gap against SparseVLM as the compression rate increases. These findings corroborate that our similarity-based selection strategy effectively isolates and preserves semantically critical visual regions, ensuring model reliability even under extreme computational constraints.

更大语言模型的性能分析。Performance analysis on a larger language model.

为了进一步评估我们的方法在极端令牌稀缺情况下的稳健性，我们在四个不同的修剪级别（保留 192、128、64 和 32 个令牌）上将 CLASP 与 SparseVLM 进行比较。 表To further evaluate the robustness of our method under extreme token scarcity, we compare CLASP against SparseVLM across four distinct pruning levels (retaining 192, 128, 64, and 32 tokens). Table11详细介绍了这些结果。 CLASP 在所有压缩比上始终优于 SparseVLM，展示了卓越的信息保留能力。 具体来说，在高保留率（192 个令牌）下，CLASP 的平均性能保留率为 98.2%，与上限非常接近。 在 64 个代币的激进剪枝水平（减少 88.9%）下，CLASP 保持了原始性能的 92.5%，显着超过 SparseVLM 的 87.3%。 即使在 32 个代币的极端约束下，基线性能急剧下降至 80.3%，CLASP 仍保持了 87.5% 的强劲表现。 这种趋势在 POPE 和 TextVQA 等细粒度任务中尤其明显，这表明我们的方法有效地保留了关键的视觉语义。details these results. CLASP consistently outperforms SparseVLM across all compression ratios, demonstrating superior information retention capabilities. Specifically, in the high-retention regime (192 tokens), CLASP achieves an average performance retention of 98.2%, closely matching the upper bound. At the aggressive pruning level of 64 tokens (88.9% reduction), CLASP maintains 92.5% of the original performance, significantly surpassing SparseVLM’s 87.3%. Even under the extreme constraint of 32 tokens, where the baseline performance drops sharply to 80.3%, CLASP sustains a robust 87.5%. This trend is particularly evident in fine-grained tasks such as POPE and TextVQA, suggesting that our method effectively preserves critical visual semantics.

不同代币预算的性能分析。Performance analysis across varying token budgets.

Vision encoders exhibit a strong depth hierarchy: shallow layers retain high-frequency local evidence (例如e.g.、边缘、笔划和精细布局），这对于 OCR 和计数密集型查询至关重要，而深层则强调不变的语义。 我们的, edges, strokes, and fine layouts) that is crucial for OCR- and counting-heavy queries, whereas deep layers emphasize invariant semantics. Our搜索衍生权重Search-derived Weights通过找到浅层/中层的混合物质量的最佳分配，有效地捕获这种归纳偏差，确保细粒度的证据不会被消除。 相比之下，进一步连续校准effectively capture this inductive bias by finding an optimal allocation of mixture mass to shallow/mid layers, ensuring that fine-grained evidence is not washed out. In contrast, further continuous calibration ofWW在有限的数据上可以表现出捷径行为：优化自然会被深层特征所吸引，这些特征会产生强大的、易于拟合的语义信号，从而产生一种深度偏差的混合，对于粗略语义来说是局部最优的，但会淡化细节敏感任务所需的精确视觉线索（on limited data can exhibit shortcut behavior: optimization is naturally attracted to deep-layer features that yield strong, easy-to-fit semantic signals, resulting in a deep-biased mixture that is locally optimal for coarse semantics but dilutes the precise visual cues required by detail-sensitive tasks (例如e.g.，文本VQA）。 这种解释与最近的 VLM 修剪研究中报告的常见消融模式一致，其中浅层/早期线索通常对于细粒度感知来说不成比例，而过度激进的跨层平均或平滑会损害以 OCR 为中心的性能。, TextVQA). This explanation is consistent with common ablation patterns reported in recent VLM pruning studies, where shallow/early cues often matter disproportionately for fine-grained perception, and overly aggressive averaging or smoothing across layers harms OCR-centric performance.

随机种子的稳健性分析。Robustness Analysis across Random Seeds.

为了严格验证 CLASP 实现的性能改进具有统计显着性，而不是随机噪声或特定初始化配置的伪影，我们对视频理解基准进行了方差分析。 具体来说，我们在以下条件下评估了我们的方法：To rigorously verify that the performance improvements achieved by CLASP are statistically significant and not artifacts of random noise or specific initialization configurations, we conducted a variance analysis on the video understanding benchmarks. Specifically, we evaluated our method under a50%50\%使用五种不同的随机种子的保留预算（retention budget using five different random seeds ([42,43,44,45,46][42,43,44,45,46]）用于冗余感知聚类初始化。 如表所示) for the redundancy-aware clustering initialization. As shown in Table21，所有三个视频基准（TGIF、MSVD、MSRVTT）的标准差都非常小（范围从, the standard deviations across all three video benchmarks (TGIF, MSVD, MSRVTT) are extremely small (ranging from±0.13\pm 0.13 to ±0.21\pm 0.21）。 此外，所有种子的平均性能始终优于在类似计算约束下评估的基线方法。 这证实了双阶段剪枝机制——特别是相似性驱动的完成阶段——是高度稳定的，并且引入的方差可以忽略不计，从而确保了稳健的表示压缩。). Furthermore, the mean performance across all seeds consistently outperforms the baseline methods evaluated under similar computational constraints. This confirms that the dual-stage pruning mechanism—particularly the similarity-driven completion stage—is highly stable and introduces negligible variance, ensuring robust representation compression.

Prompt-to-Class 路由器的稳健性。Robustness of the Prompt-to-Class Router.

为了进一步评估意图分类器的稳健性并了解潜在路由错误的影响，我们进行了两次模拟压力测试。 首先，我们通过强制将特定比例的样本分配到“默认”类别来模拟分类器的不确定性。 其次，我们通过将一定比例的样本随机错误分类到不正确的非默认类别来模拟关键路由失败。To further evaluate the robustness of our intent classifier and understand the impact of potential routing errors, we conduct two simulated stress tests. First, we simulate classifier uncertainty by forcing a specific proportion of samples to be assigned to the “Default” category. Second, we simulate critical routing failures by randomly misclassifying a certain ratio of samples into incorrect non-default categories.
